title: P60_Blood
treatment_protocol_ch1: Tumor and adjacent normal lung tissue samples were gently cut in approximately 1mm3 pieces. Tissues were digested enzymatically, by an incubation of 20-40 minutes, based on the size of the tissue, at 37oC in agitation, in C02-independent medium (Invitrogen) with Collagenase I (2mg/ml, Sigma-Aldrich), Hyaluronidase (2mg/ml, Sigma-Aldrich) and DNase (25μg/ml, Sigma-Aldrich). The tissue pieces were gently triturated with a 20 ml syringe plunger on a 40 μ m cell strainer (BD) in 1X PBS (Invitrogen) with 1% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 2mM EDTA (Gibco) until uniform cell suspensions were obtained. The suspended cells were subsequently centrifuged for 10 minutes at 400g and resuspended in PBS 1X buffer with 1% FBS and 2mM EDTA (Gibco). Isolation of tumor infiltrating lymphocytes and peripheral blood mononuclear cells was performed using Ficoll-paque PLUS solution (Sigma-Aldrich). CD3+ T cell isolationwas performed using CD3 microbeads and MACS separation (Miltenyi). Susequently dead cells and debris was removed following SOP (Dead cell removal kit; Debris removal kit; Miltenyi Biotec). Purified CD3+ T cells were resuspended in 1X PBS buffer with 0.04% BSA.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA from P34, P35, P42, P43 and P46 was extracted according to the Single Cell 3' Reagent Kits V2. RNA from P47, P55, P57, P58 and P61 was extracted according to the Single Cell VDJ 5' Reagent Kits
3' single cell RNA-seq; 5' for paired single cell RNA/TCR-seq

metadata.source_clinical_code_policy: Original stage/histology/smoking codes retained in GEO metadata. LiteralNA mapped to missing for canonical fields; no code correction or healthy-status inference.
metadata.source_disease_context: GEO design and primaryPMID33514641 describe untreated primaryNSCLC patients, with matched tumor/blood source codes.
metadata.source_coverage_limitation: Blood-derived lymphocyte/T-cell study context. Precise enrichment fraction not independently joined; no claim of unselected whole-PBMC coverage.
metadata.source_cell_selection: P57 deposited unfiltered RNA whitelist; primary describes EmptyDrops cell calls but final cell assignments not joined. Existing500count/200gene/20percentmito collectionQC applies; no independent cell-call calibration.
metadata.source_demographics: Reported sex and clinical codes retained; individual age, exact collection dates and detailed treatment histories not joined or imputed.
metadata.source_alias_review: Four explicit blood donorsP57/P58/P60/P61. Tumor/juxtatumor/receptor data andsuperseriesGSE162500 arepairedreadouts/aliases, notadditionalbloodobservations.
metadata.source_gene_processing: All native RNA coordinates retained; original count archives only, no author integrated/Harmony/UMAP geometry.
